facts.fact: 总部星巴克没有空椅子，KRAY 与 BUTTONFLY 端着咖啡走到自助餐厅旁的中庭。
facts.anchor: There were no empty chairs down at the Headquarters Starbucks, so KRAY and BUTTONFLY took their coffees out to the interior courtyard beside the cafeteria.

facts.fact: 两人走到十二英尺高的 Kryptos 雕塑旁，雕塑上藏着许多加密讯息。
facts.anchor: They walked over to the twelve-foot-high Kryptos sculpture, with its many secret messages hidden in code.

facts.fact: 中情局在 1990 年以 25 万美元从美国艺术家 Jim Sanborn 手中买下这件作品。
facts.anchor: the Agency had bought the piece from American artist Jim Sanborn back in 1990 for $250,000

facts.fact: 雕塑文字包含四段独立密讯，外界所知只有三段被破解。
facts.anchor: The texts comprised four separate secret messages, only three of which had been solved, at least so far as anybody knew.

facts.fact: BUTTONFLY 自称早在 1992 年就解出了整座雕塑。
facts.anchor: I solved this thing back in ’92, by the way

facts.fact: KRAY 的线人全都说从未听说任何 GOOWIKI 部署，一个都没有。
facts.anchor: They told me they’d never heard of any GOOWIKI deployments. Not one.

facts.fact: 接头三人中 STUCCO 未能见面、VESUVIUS 爽约，KRYSTE 在马德里酒吧被找到。
facts.anchor: STUCCO couldn’t meet. VESUVIUS was a no-show. I found KRYSTE at the Madrid Bar.

facts.fact: 第五段也是最后一段密文其实是一则敲门笑话。
facts.anchor: the fifth and final Kryptos Text, the riddle within a riddle, was in fact a knock-knock joke
